### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

Rich MySQL terminal client with auto-completion, syntax highlighting, and dataframes. Homepage: [https://mycli.net](https://mycli.net) Documentation: [https://mycli.net/docs](https://mycli.net/docs) Mycli is known to be compatible with * [MySQL](https://www.mysql.com/) * [MariaDB](https://mariadb.org/) * [Percona](https://www.percona.com/) * [TiDB](https://www.pingcap.com/) * [Apache Doris](https://doris.apache.org/) Postgres equivalent * [pgcli](https://pgcli.com) Release 2.0.0 has [breaking changes](https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/blob/v2.0.0/changelog.md#breaking-changes)!
